name: Miami-Dade County - Digital accessibility (ADA Notice)
applies_to: County digital service channels including miamidade.gov.
requires: Adopted WCAG 2.1 AA as the County standard
Online grievance form for accessibility barriers
Departmental ADA coordinators; County ADA Office in the Internal Services Department
enforcement: County ADA Office grievances; federal Title II.
notes: No Implementing Order specific to digital accessibility was found. The separate Clerk of Court site states a WCAG 2.0 AA target.
